title: Slay the Spire 2 updates are slowing down again, but a new character and alternate act are next
author: editor@pcgamesn.com
contents:
In its August Slay the Spire 2 Neowsletter, developer Mega Crit reveals it's actively working on another Act Two and the next new character.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: Slay the Spire 2 updates are slowing down again, but a new character and alternate act are next
